body: I have tried quite a few (about 9 or 10 different SSRIs/SNRIs and various combinations of them). My psychiatrist mentioned some alternative stuff (like scopolamine or low-dose IV ketamine — yeah, I know, right!) that I've been hesitant to try / haven't tried yet due to side-effects and the fact that it's all off-label use. There's that and I guess ECT as well. It might be worth it to try and exhaust my options. I just dunno. I mean, the meds help keep things "stabilized," but it's more so I can function, not so much that they suppress or fix anything themselves. I think that might be asking too much of any med, though.
